Hi Samantha — thanks for the spreadsheet and the timeline. We can meet the June 7 procurement checkpoint with a staged delivery and support the June 24–28 audit window with a short evidence sprint. High-level proposal below; I'll coordinate the intake and Ben will lead evidence ingestion.

Staged plan (summary):
1) Today — intake: we reviewed your spreadsheet and mapped the first pass of controls to Redwood capabilities. See attached crosswalk (redwood_control-crosswalk_v1.xlsx).
2) Week of May 13 — triage call (30m) to confirm in-scope controls and any control re-mapping requests. Proposed time: Tue 5/14 10:00am PT.
3) May 15–24 — evidence collection window (our team will upload artifacts and short writeups to your shared folder). We will prioritize high-risk controls first.
4) Jun 3 — preliminary evidence packet submitted to procurement/legal for review.
5) Jun 24–28 — audit window readiness: on-call team and quick clarifications.

In-scope: SOC 2 (Security, Availability, Confidentiality) and ISO 27001 baseline items. If you require SOC 2 subservice details for other trusts (e.g., Processing Integrity), flag them in the triage call.

Artifacts we expect to provide (examples):
- Control narrative (short explanation of how the control is implemented)
- Configuration exports or screenshots (e.g., firewall rules, VPC flow logs examples)
- Operational logs (redacted) and retention statements
- Key management evidence: KMS policy, rotation schedule, auditor-facing key usage logs or attestations (we'll supply proof of customer-data-at-rest encryption and KMS integration)

Contacts:
- Marissa Cole — primary: intake coordination and procurement questions (marissa_cole@redwood.com)
- Ben Carter — evidence ingestion lead (ben_carter@redwood.com)
- Karthik Iyer — technical clarifications and cryptography questions (karthik_iyer@redwood.com)

Attachments: redwood_control-crosswalk_v1.xlsx; evidence_upload_instructions.pdf

Thanks — I'll send a calendar invite for the triage call if Tue 5/14 works.

Best,

Samantha / team — quick operational plan from our side (tracking items so procurement has clear SLAs):

1) Evidence queue and priority buckets
- P0 (must-have before Jun 7): encryption-in-transit proof, KMS rotation policy, SOC 2 security description, and network segmentation diagram.
- P1 (by May 24): incident response runbook, patching cadence logs (last 90 days), and privileged access matrix.
- P2 (by Jun 3): longer retention samples and internal audit notes (redacted).

2) Evidence formats and location
- We will upload artifacts to the Helix evidence folder (Drive link provided below) and attach short assertion notes (one-paragraph) per artifact. For large log exports we will provide filtered extracts with hash values.
- Preferred filename convention: HE-4932_<controlID>_<artifact-type>_v1.pdf/xlsx

3) Access & verification
- If you want hands-on verification, we can provision a time-limited read-only link for a technical reviewer. Request via the triage call.

4) Escalation & SLAs
- Triage responses within 24 business hours for P0/P1; 48 hours for P2. On-call during Jun 24–28 audit window (phone + Slack).

Practical asks for your team to speed ingestion:
- Confirm which controls are strictly in scope (column B in your sheet) so we can order P0 artifacts correctly.
- If legal requires notarized or audited artifacts, mark those controls now (otherwise we’ll provide standard attestations).

HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/HE-4932
Drive: https://drive.redwood.com/teams/assurance/helix-evidence-folder

Ben Carter

Marissa / Ben — thanks for the rapid plan. Confirmed: Tue 5/14 10:00am PT works for our triage call. A couple of clarifications from procurement/legal before the call so we can be productive:

- For encryption-in-transit, we need an artifact showing TLS configuration (cipher suites, min TLS version) for public endpoints and sample curl output demonstrating the negotiated cipher.
- For KMS, Helix requires a statement of whether keys are customer-provided or managed by Redwood; if managed, we need KMS separation-of-duties documentation.
- Please confirm whether any artifacts will contain customer PII and if so what redaction process you will follow.

We'll prepare a short intake spreadsheet (one column: absolute must-have by Jun 7) and share it in the triage call. Looking forward to the call and the read-only folder approach — that will speed reviewers.
